description: Check a relay: the user opened https://synthhub.roomi-fields.com/connect/ (or ran osc-bridge connect) and gave you its pairing code. Returns the MIDI output and input ports of their machine. Nothing is sent to the hardware.

code.description: The pairing code the relay page or program shows (e.g. 'K7QM-2XPA').

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: relay_status
